_comment: Config of the external attack campaign orchestrator (security/external/campaign.py). The families run in the order of the rules of engagement (docs/en/external-attack-campaigns.md); denial of service is last. 'driver' families are run by campaign.py; 'manual' families (active DAST, DoS) are run by hand in the window and their reports read if present; the supply-chain guards are enforced in mairie360/CICD. The controls table is the state at the close of the epic: every control is implemented and awaits validation by the first campaign.

families.label: Reconnaissance
families.criterion: no deviation from expected.json (ports, subdomains, banners, admin, leaks, DNS, mail)

families.label: Authentication, sessions and tokens
families.criterion: progressive per-IP and per-account block, uniform responses, every invalid token refused

families.label: Access control
families.criterion: 403/401 out of the matrix, no other account's data in a response

families.label: Active scan (injection, browser-side, server-side)
families.criterion: no High alert; each Medium a finding; errors without technical detail

families.label: Business logic and no-session abuse
families.criterion: every business rule holds server-side, an e-mail cap per account and per IP

families.label: Supply chain
families.criterion: enforced in mairie360/CICD (zizmor blocking, guard tests); no secret read nor workflow modified from a fork, unsigned image refused

families.label: Application denial of service
families.criterion: 429/413 not 5xx, no pod restarted, memory under limit, legit p95 under threshold, self-recovery
